about: Halifax Regional Municipality covers a large area of central Nova Scotia, from an Atlantic harbour city to surrounding suburbs and coastline. Downtown Halifax sits on a peninsula opposite Dartmouth, with a major port and naval base. The regional municipality was formed by amalgamating several former cities and counties. About 440,000 people live in the municipality.
seoSummary: Atlantic Canada’s largest urban centre, a harbour city and regional municipality.
knownFor: Ice-free Atlantic port and naval base
Citadel Hill and a historic downtown
Maritime museums and the waterfront boardwalk
Amalgamated urban, suburban, and coastal communities
